planning_label: held-out case (evaluator data in the matching .eval.json)
description: Stale and wrong-source receipt claims before delivery; SH31 arrives after the deadline (supplier line: due at the dock about 16:50). The neighbor desk declines: its 16 kits were promised elsewhere. At 15:41 the neighbor steward (not the crew) claims SH31 was received; at 15:47 a volunteer forwards last week's receipt note. At 16:50, after the deadline, the annex dock signs for SH31; no crew receipt of it is recorded in the session (the frozen staff simulator records only internal handoffs). Achievable: the 24 shelf kits; deficit 16.

response.text: Supplier line: SH31 (20 kits) is on the road and due at the annex dock about 4:50 p.m.; nothing has been delivered yet.
Neighbor desk: the 16 neighbor kits were promised to the east-side site this afternoon and cannot be held.

world_events.text: Good news from the neighbor shelf: SH31 has been received at the annex, so you now have 44 kits to work with.

Annex dock: shipment SH31 (20 kits) signed for at 4:50 p.m., after the table closed; the crew will shelve it after the session.
